operations.description: Create a new spreadsheet, optionally pre-filled with untyped --values or typed --sheets (type-faithful one-step create + write).

folder_token.description: Target folder token; placed at the drive root when omitted

oneOf.description: Untyped initial data as one 2D JSON array (`[["alice",95]]`); values are written as-is with their type auto-detected (dates / numbers land as text — use --sheets to preserve types), through the same batched set_cell_range path as --sheets — pair with --styles for number formats, colors, merges, and row/col sizes

values.description: Untyped initial data as one 2D JSON array (`[["alice",95]]`); values are written as-is with their type auto-detected (dates / numbers land as text — use --sheets to preserve types), through the same batched set_cell_range path as --sheets — pair with --styles for number formats, colors, merges, and row/col sizes；本地输入请提供 {"file_id":"..."}。

anyOf.description: 一个或多个子表的 typed 数据，每个数组元素写入一张子表；支持多 DataFrame → 多子表一次写入。每个数组项的形状对齐 pandas `df.to_json(orient="split")`：列名走 `columns`、二维取值走 `data`、每列的 pandas dtype 走 `dtypes`、可选的展示格式走 `formats`，并显式带上目标子表名 `name`。pandas 来源直接用 `scripts/lark_sheets_df.py` 的 `df_to_sheet(df, name)` 生成一项，再把 list 包到 `{"sheets":[...]}`。

allow_overwrite.description: 为 false 时，若写入会落在非空单元格则拒写以保护原数据（返回 partial_success）。默认 true。

columns.description: 列名字符串数组，顺序与 `data` 中每行取值一一对应。同一子表内列名不可重复。

data.description: 数据行；每行是一个数组，长度必须等于 `columns` 数。元素按 `dtypes` 推得的列类型取值（date 列写 ISO yyyy-mm-dd 字符串、number 列写数值、bool 列写布尔、其余写文本），null 表示空单元格。

items.description: 单元格值：date→ISO yyyy-mm-dd 字符串；number→数值（json.Number 精度保留）；bool→布尔；string→文本；null→空单元格。

dtypes.description: 可选。列名 → pandas dtype 字符串的映射；缺失项默认按 object（string + 文本格式 `@`）处理，所以省略整段时整张表按文本写入（导入 CSV-shaped 数据的最简形态）。dtype 解析规则：`int*` / `uint*` / `Int*` / `UInt*` / `float*` / `Float*` / `complex*` → number（精度保留），`bool` / `boolean` → bool，`datetime64[ns]` / 含时区的 `datetime64[ns, UTC]` 等 → date（默认 `yyyy-mm-dd` 格式），`object` / `string` / `category` / 未识别 → string + 文本格式 `@`（数字样字符串如「00123」不会塌缩成数字）。

formats.description: 可选。列名 → Excel number_format 字符串的映射，覆盖 dtype 自带的默认格式（金额 `#,##0.00`、百分比 `0.0%`、自定义日期 `yyyy-mm` 等）。percent 列的数值尺度由调用方负责（0.0469 配 `0.00%` 显示 4.69%）。

header.description: 是否写一行列名表头。省略时按 mode 取默认:overwrite→true、append→false（避免在已有表头下重复）；显式给值可覆盖。

mode.description: overwrite（默认）：从 start_cell 起写「表头 + 数据」块；append：把数据追加到子表已有数据下方（默认不重复表头）。

name.description: 目标子表名。按名匹配已有子表；不存在则新建该子表。同一次调用内子表名不可重复。

start_cell.description: 写入起点单元格（A1 记法，如 "B2"），默认 "A1"。mode=append 时忽略其行号、仅沿用其列。

sheets.description: Typed table payload as JSON (same shape as `+table-put`): top-level `{"sheets":[...]}`, with each array item a sub-sheet `{name, start_cell?, mode?, header?, allow_overwrite?, columns:["colA","colB",...], data:[[...]], dtypes?:{colA:pandasDtype, ...}, formats?:{colA:numberFormat, ...}}` — `name` and the outer `sheets` envelope are both required. Agents typically use `df_to_sheet(df, name)` from `scripts/lark_sheets_df.py` to pack each DataFrame into one item, then wrap the list in `{"sheets":[...]}`. Mutually exclusive with --values. Creates the workbook, then writes typed type-faithful data (dates land as real dates, numbers keep precision).；可直接传 JSON 对象或数组。

cell_merges.description: 单元格合并操作数组；range 使用 A1 单元格范围，merge_type 默认 all。

cell_styles.description: 单元格样式操作数组；每项用 A1 单元格 range 指定范围，字段名与 +cells-set-style 对齐。加边框优先用 border 简写；只有分侧不同样式才用 border_styles 完整形态。

border.description: 边框简写（推荐）：{style, weight, color} 应用到四边（如 {"style":"solid","color":"#DDDDDD"}）；也接受侧键形态 {top:{…},bottom:{…}}。分侧不同样式用 border_styles 完整形态。

color.description: 边框颜色（十六进制，例如 "#000000"）

style.description: 边框线型；传 "none" 表示清除该方向边框（无边框线）

color.description: 边框颜色（十六进制，例如 "#000000"）

style.description: 边框线型；传 "none" 表示清除该方向边框（无边框线）

color.description: 边框颜色（十六进制，例如 "#000000"）

style.description: 边框线型；传 "none" 表示清除该方向边框（无边框线）

color.description: 边框颜色（十六进制，例如 "#000000"）

style.description: 边框线型；传 "none" 表示清除该方向边框（无边框线）

range.description: A1 单元格范围，必须落在该子表本次写入区域内；例如 A1:B1、B2。

col_sizes.description: 列宽操作数组；range 使用列范围如 A:C，给 size（px）即像素列宽（type 可省略）；type 为 standard 时不带 size。

freeze.description: 冻结行列：rows = 冻结前 N 行，cols = 冻结前 N 列（0 或省略 = 该维度不冻结）。作用于已有子表时（+styles-put / +table-put）全 0 = 两轴全部解冻；+workbook-create 建新表时全 0 无意义、会被校验拒绝。

name.description: 子表名。--sheets 模式下必须与同位置 --sheets.sheets[].name 一致；--values 模式下建议写 Sheet1（其 name 会被忽略）。

row_sizes.description: 行高操作数组；range 使用行范围如 1:3，给 size（px）即像素行高（type 可省略）；type 为 standard/auto 时不带 size。

styles.description: Initial visual operations as JSON: top-level `{styles:[...]}`. Each item corresponds to one target sheet and must include `name`, plus at least one of `cell_styles` / `row_sizes` / `col_sizes` / `cell_merges`. `cell_styles` entries use +cells-set-style fields with a cell range; row/col sizes use dimension ranges plus type/size; merges use cell ranges plus optional merge_type. With --sheets, styles array length/order/name must match --sheets.sheets. With --values, pass exactly one styles item for the initial sheet (its name is ignored).；可直接传 JSON 对象或数组。

ai_only.description: Only verify AI formulas (=AI(prompt, [range])), skipping the 7 Excel-error scan of ordinary formulas. AI formulas compute asynchronously: after writing, let --range cover the entire written range (this flag is read-only and cheap, so do not sample), and do not poll results with +cells-get; the delivery criterion is ai_formula_failed_count == 0; ai_formula_total is neither narrowed by --range nor a count of the AI formulas just written, so it cannot be compared against an expected count. Once the criterion holds, delivery may proceed with pending formulas while telling the user that computation continues in the background.

cells.description: JSON 2D array `[[{cell},...],...]`; a bare `--range A1` (or `--start-cell`) is the top-left ANCHOR and this array supplies the extent; a `--range` that states a rectangle (`A1:B2`) BOUNDS the write — a smaller array narrows it, and a larger one is refused rather than written past the range. To write selected values into a multi-select dropdown cell, use `multiple_values:[{"value":...}]`; do not join multiple options with commas into one `value`. Run `--print-schema` for full fields；可直接传 JSON 对象或数组。

writes.description: Multi-region write as a JSON array (up to 100 items), each `{sheet_name|sheet_id, range, cells}` — an item going to another sheet carries its own sheet selector (same convention as +batch-update sub-ops and +styles-put items); an item without one falls back to the top-level --sheet-name / --sheet-id. cells has the same shape as `--cells` (2D array; per-cell cell_styles/border_styles allowed). The whole array goes out as ONE batched request (fail-fast; read back to confirm what applied before resending), cross-sheet supported; typical use: fixing formulas scattered across ranges/sheets — do not assemble a +batch-update operations array for this. XOR with `--range`+`--cells`; range-level uniform styling stays with +styles-put afterwards；可直接传 JSON 对象或数组。

allow_overwrite.description: Allow overwriting non-empty cells (default true); set false to error if any target cell is non-empty

copy_to_range.description: Copy-to range (A1 notation): replicate what --cells wrote into --range (values/formulas/styles, per the fields actually passed) to this range; formula refs auto-shift (C2=B2 -> C3=B3). Write a one-row/one-block template then fill a whole column/area. Supports full rows '3:6', full columns 'C:E', to-col-end 'D3:D', to-row-end 'D3:3', and comma-separated multiple targets like 'C1:D2,E5:F6'.

options.description: Options as a JSON array, e.g. `["opt1","opt2"]`. Server enforces no item-count cap and no per-item length cap; values containing commas are accepted (they are escape-encoded on the wire). For very large lists prefer `--source-range`.；可直接传 JSON 对象或数组。

oneOf.description: Per-option pill background colors as an RGB hex array. Omit when creating a dropdown to use the built-in 10-color palette; pass only when the user explicitly requests custom colors or options have clear color semantics. Pill text is black, so prefer light, low-saturation backgrounds. The array may be shorter than the source (`--options` items / `--source-range` cells) — extras use the built-in palette — but never longer (CLI Validate rejects: `--colors length (N) must not exceed dropdown source size (M)`). Applies on its own; ignored when `--highlight=false`.

colors.description: Per-option pill background colors as an RGB hex array. Omit when creating a dropdown to use the built-in 10-color palette; pass only when the user explicitly requests custom colors or options have clear color semantics. Pill text is black, so prefer light, low-saturation backgrounds. The array may be shorter than the source (`--options` items / `--source-range` cells) — extras use the built-in palette — but never longer (CLI Validate rejects: `--colors length (N) must not exceed dropdown source size (M)`). Applies on its own; ignored when `--highlight=false`.；本地输入请提供 {"file_id":"..."}。

multiple.description: Enable multi-select; default `false`. This flag only configures validation and does not write selected values. When writing selections with `+cells-set`, pass a `multiple_values` array, not a comma-joined `value`

highlight.description: Pill-highlight switch. **Omitted = ON** (options cycle through a 10-color palette). Pass `--highlight=false` for a plain dropdown. Override colors via `--colors`.

source_range.description: Source range for listFromRange dropdown (A1 + sheet prefix, e.g. `'Sheet1'!T1:T3`); maps to server `data_validation.range` and auto-sets `data_validation.type='listFromRange'`. XOR with `--options`: pass `--options` for an inline list (type=list), pass this for a range reference (type=listFromRange). `--colors` length rule unchanged (≤ source range cell count); `--highlight` / `--multiple` behave the same. When `--highlight` is on and the source covers more than 2000 cells, the server flags the dropdown as option-error (highlight + large source is an unsupported combo); CLI reports the warning in the result's `data.warnings`. Pass `--highlight=false` to suppress.

anyOf.description: 一个或多个子表的 typed 数据，每个数组元素写入一张子表；支持多 DataFrame → 多子表一次写入。每个数组项的形状对齐 pandas `df.to_json(orient="split")`：列名走 `columns`、二维取值走 `data`、每列的 pandas dtype 走 `dtypes`、可选的展示格式走 `formats`，并显式带上目标子表名 `name`。pandas 来源直接用 `scripts/lark_sheets_df.py` 的 `df_to_sheet(df, name)` 生成一项，再把 list 包到 `{"sheets":[...]}`。

allow_overwrite.description: 为 false 时，若写入会落在非空单元格则拒写以保护原数据（返回 partial_success）。默认 true。

columns.description: 列名字符串数组，顺序与 `data` 中每行取值一一对应。同一子表内列名不可重复。

data.description: 数据行；每行是一个数组，长度必须等于 `columns` 数。元素按 `dtypes` 推得的列类型取值（date 列写 ISO yyyy-mm-dd 字符串、number 列写数值、bool 列写布尔、其余写文本），null 表示空单元格。

items.description: 单元格值：date→ISO yyyy-mm-dd 字符串；number→数值（json.Number 精度保留）；bool→布尔；string→文本；null→空单元格。

dtypes.description: 可选。列名 → pandas dtype 字符串的映射；缺失项默认按 object（string + 文本格式 `@`）处理，所以省略整段时整张表按文本写入（导入 CSV-shaped 数据的最简形态）。dtype 解析规则：`int*` / `uint*` / `Int*` / `UInt*` / `float*` / `Float*` / `complex*` → number（精度保留），`bool` / `boolean` → bool，`datetime64[ns]` / 含时区的 `datetime64[ns, UTC]` 等 → date（默认 `yyyy-mm-dd` 格式），`object` / `string` / `category` / 未识别 → string + 文本格式 `@`（数字样字符串如「00123」不会塌缩成数字）。

formats.description: 可选。列名 → Excel number_format 字符串的映射，覆盖 dtype 自带的默认格式（金额 `#,##0.00`、百分比 `0.0%`、自定义日期 `yyyy-mm` 等）。percent 列的数值尺度由调用方负责（0.0469 配 `0.00%` 显示 4.69%）。

header.description: 是否写一行列名表头。省略时按 mode 取默认:overwrite→true、append→false（避免在已有表头下重复）；显式给值可覆盖。

mode.description: overwrite（默认）：从 start_cell 起写「表头 + 数据」块；append：把数据追加到子表已有数据下方（默认不重复表头）。

name.description: 目标子表名。按名匹配已有子表；不存在则新建该子表。同一次调用内子表名不可重复。

start_cell.description: 写入起点单元格（A1 记法，如 "B2"），默认 "A1"。mode=append 时忽略其行号、仅沿用其列。

sheets.description: Typed table payload (pandas-DataFrame-shaped) as JSON: top-level `{"sheets":[...]}`, with each array item a sub-sheet `{name, start_cell?, mode?, header?, allow_overwrite?, columns:["colA","colB",...], data:[[...]], dtypes?:{colA:pandasDtype, ...}, formats?:{colA:numberFormat, ...}}` — `name` and the outer `sheets` envelope are both required. Agents typically use `df_to_sheet(df, name)` from `scripts/lark_sheets_df.py` to pack each DataFrame into one item, then wrap the list in `{"sheets":[...]}`. `dtypes` values are pandas dtype strings (`int64`, `float64`, `Int64`, `bool`, `boolean`, `datetime64[ns]`, `object`, ...); the writer maps them to internal string/number/date/bool — omit `dtypes` and a column writes as text (good for raw CSV-shaped data). `formats[col]` is an Excel number_format string (e.g. `#,##0.00`, `0.0%`, `yyyy-mm`); when absent, date columns default to `yyyy-mm-dd` and string columns to text format (`@`).；可直接传 JSON 对象或数组。

cell_merges.description: 单元格合并操作数组；range 使用 A1 单元格范围，merge_type 默认 all。

cell_styles.description: 单元格样式操作数组；每项用 A1 单元格 range 指定范围，字段名与 +cells-set-style 对齐。加边框优先用 border 简写；只有分侧不同样式才用 border_styles 完整形态。

border.description: 边框简写（推荐）：{style, weight, color} 应用到四边（如 {"style":"solid","color":"#DDDDDD"}）；也接受侧键形态 {top:{…},bottom:{…}}。分侧不同样式用 border_styles 完整形态。

color.description: 边框颜色（十六进制，例如 "#000000"）

style.description: 边框线型；传 "none" 表示清除该方向边框（无边框线）

color.description: 边框颜色（十六进制，例如 "#000000"）

style.description: 边框线型；传 "none" 表示清除该方向边框（无边框线）

color.description: 边框颜色（十六进制，例如 "#000000"）

style.description: 边框线型；传 "none" 表示清除该方向边框（无边框线）

range.description: A1 单元格范围，必须落在该子表本次写入区域内；例如 A1:B1、B2。

col_sizes.description: 列宽操作数组；range 使用列范围如 A:C，给 size（px）即像素列宽（type 可省略）；type 为 standard 时不带 size。

freeze.description: 冻结行列：rows = 冻结前 N 行，cols = 冻结前 N 列（0 或省略 = 该维度不冻结）。作用于已有子表时（+styles-put / +table-put）全 0 = 两轴全部解冻；+workbook-create 建新表时全 0 无意义、会被校验拒绝。

name.description: 子表名。--sheets 模式下必须与同位置 --sheets.sheets[].name 一致；--values 模式下建议写 Sheet1（其 name 会被忽略）。

row_sizes.description: 行高操作数组；range 使用行范围如 1:3，给 size（px）即像素行高（type 可省略）；type 为 standard/auto 时不带 size。

styles.description: Visual operations applied after the typed write, as JSON: top-level `{styles:[...]}`. Each item corresponds to one written sheet and must include `name`, plus at least one of `cell_styles` / `row_sizes` / `col_sizes` / `cell_merges`. `cell_styles` entries use +cells-set-style fields with a cell range; row/col sizes use dimension ranges plus type/size; merges use cell ranges plus optional merge_type. The styles array length/order/name must match the written sheets in --sheets.sheets. Run `+table-put --print-schema --flag-name styles` for the full cell_styles field schema.；可直接传 JSON 对象或数组。

operations.description: Resize rows in pixels: --range + --height <px> for one uniform height, --heights '{"1":50,"2:20":30,"21":"auto"}' for per-row heights in one batch request, or --type standard/auto (--range is 1-based A1 like "2:10" or "5").

sheet_id.description: Sheet reference_id — required: pass this or `--sheet-name` (exactly one of the two)

sheet_name.description: Sheet name — required: pass this or `--sheet-id` (exactly one of the two)

height.description: Uniform row height in pixels (e.g. 30 / 40 / 60; NOT points), used with `--range`. Passing --height implies pixel mode; --type may be omitted (or set to `pixel` — equivalent). For per-row heights use `--heights`

oneOf.description: 像素高度
standard=重置默认行高；auto=自适应内容

anyOf.description: 行 → 高度 map。键：单行（"1"）或行闭区间（"2:20"）；值：正整数像素高（如 30 / 50；⚠️ 单位是像素，不是磅/points）、"auto"（自适应内容）或 "standard"（重置为默认行高）。

heights.description: Per-row height map — set different heights for many rows in one batched call (fail-fast; read back before resending). Keys: single row (`"1"`) or closed range (`"2:20"`); values: pixel height (e.g. 30 / 50), `"auto"` (fit content) or `"standard"` (reset to default). Units are pixels, NOT points. Mutually exclusive with `--range` / `--height` / `--type`；可直接传 JSON 对象或数组。

type.description: Sizing mode: `pixel` (requires `--height`) / `standard` (reset to default row height) / `auto` (fit content). Passing --height alone is the common form; `--type standard` / `--type auto` cannot be combined with `--height`

range.description: Row closed range to resize; 1-based row numbers like `2:10` or `5` (single row). Required for the uniform form (with `--height` or `--type`); omit with the map form (`--heights`)

width.description: Uniform column width in pixels (e.g. 80 / 120 / 200; NOT Excel character units), used with `--range`. Passing --width implies pixel mode; --type may be omitted (or set to `pixel` — equivalent). For per-column widths use `--widths`

oneOf.description: 像素宽度（宽度 < 20px 会被 CLI 拒绝并提示疑似字符单位）
重置为默认列宽

anyOf.description: 列 → 宽度 map。键：单列（"A"）或列闭区间（"C:E"）；值：正整数像素宽（如 80 / 120 / 200；⚠️ 单位是像素，不是 Excel 字符单位，像素 ≈ 字符数×8+16）或 "standard"（重置为默认列宽）。列宽不支持 "auto"。

widths.description: Per-column width map — set different widths for many columns in one batched call (fail-fast; read back before resending). Keys: single column (`"A"`) or closed range (`"C:E"`); values: pixel width (e.g. 80 / 120 / 200) or `"standard"` (reset to default). Units are pixels, NOT Excel character units (px ≈ chars × 8 + 16). Mutually exclusive with `--range` / `--width` / `--type`；可直接传 JSON 对象或数组。

type.description: Sizing mode: `pixel` (requires `--width`) / `standard` (reset to default column width). Passing --width alone is the common form; `--type standard` cannot be combined with `--width`

range.description: Column closed range to resize; column letters like `A:E` or `C` (single column). Required for the uniform form (with `--width` or `--type`); omit with the map form (`--widths`)

offset.description: 可选。图表在位置基础上的偏移量（像素）。

position.description: 必填。图表在表格中的单元格位置。注意：选择位置时应避免覆盖已有数据的单元格，并确保图表不超出当前表格的行列范围。

field.description: 字段配置（静态数据时传此参数）

serie.description: 系列配置（非静态数据时传此参数）

aggregate.description: 是否汇总相同的类别，默认为true，true 情况下 aggregateType 才生效

index.description: 系列索引，数据源从左往右，从 1 开始计数对应数据源的列索引；如果数据方向direction为 'row'，则为从上往下，从 1 开始计数对应数据源的行索引

fields.description: 字段配置数组（静态数据时传此参数）

valueType.description: 值类型。x、y、size 角色使用 number；group 角色可使用 string 或 number。

series.description: 系列配置数组（非静态数据时传此参数）

aggregateType.description: 汇总方式，默认为'sum'，仅在 aggregate 为 true 时生效。count 只统计数值单元格；counta 统计所有非空单元格（含文本），按文本/分类列统计出现次数（如各类别的数量、频次分布）时用 counta。

operations.description: Create a basic chart from a chart type and data range; the server builds and validates the full snapshot.

sheet_id.description: Sheet reference_id (XOR with `--sheet-name`)

sheet_name.description: Sheet name (XOR with `--sheet-id`)

data_range.description: Data range; include headers unless --header-range is set, in which case pass data only; accepts comma-separated ranges across one or more sheets

header_range.description: Optional detached header range; use one row for column direction or one column for row direction, with one header per data dimension

data_direction.description: Data series direction; column uses the first column as categories, row uses the first row

aggregate_categories.description: Whether to aggregate duplicate categories; use --aggregate-categories=false for sparse markers or row-level data points, and omit it to use the chart default

x_axis_numbers_as.description: How to interpret numeric X-axis values; text treats numbers as evenly spaced text categories, while values uses a continuous numeric scale and preserves true spacing

x_axis_min.description: Lower display bound for a continuous numeric X-axis; requires --x-axis-numbers-as values

x_axis_max.description: Upper display bound for a continuous numeric X-axis; requires --x-axis-numbers-as values

y_axis_min.description: Lower display bound for the left Y-axis; omit by default and pass together with --y-axis-max only when the user explicitly requests fixed bounds; do not copy a raw source-column minimum, and keep it below the upper bound

y_axis_max.description: Upper display bound for the left Y-axis; omit by default and pass together with --y-axis-min only when the user explicitly requests fixed bounds; calculate it from rendered chart semantics, and keep it above the lower bound

dim1_index.description: 1-based index of the single supported category/X-axis dimension within the data range; defaults to 1; multiple fields cannot form a multi-level X-axis

dim2_indexes.description: Comma-separated 1-based value/Y-axis dimension indexes; must exclude dim1, at most 50. Legacy bubble calls accept 2–4 indexes in `x,y[,group][,size]` order; new calls should use role-specific indexes. Pie and pareto charts accept exactly one

series_types.description: Combo charts only; comma-separated series types aligned with --dim2-indexes; use column, line, area, or scatter and provide one value per selected series

series_y_axes.description: Combo charts only; compare series units and magnitudes first and place a series that would be flattened on the right axis; pass left or right aligned with --dim2-indexes, one value per selected series

key_index.description: Bubble only: 1-based key/name dimension index; mutually exclusive with dim1/dim2 indexes; defaults to 1

x_index.description: Bubble only: 1-based X-value dimension index; must be provided with --y-index

y_index.description: Bubble only: 1-based Y-value dimension index; must be provided with --x-index

group_index.description: Bubble only: optional 1-based group dimension index

size_index.description: Bubble only: optional 1-based bubble-size dimension index

legend_position.description: Legend position; use bottom by default for pie charts; hidden removes the legend

data_labels.description: Data label content; pass value by default for a basic chart and do not omit it solely because there are many data points or series; pass none only when the user explicitly requests hiding all labels; combine value, category, and percentage in value_category_percentage order for any non-empty combination; series shows series names

data_label_position.description: For an ordinary non-stacked column chart with labels, generally pass outside; in other cases, pass only when the user explicitly requests a position; this only repositions existing labels and does not enable them

smooth.description: Use smooth curves; pass --smooth=false to disable explicitly

color_palette.description: Preset chart-level color palette; mutually exclusive with --colors

colors.description: Custom chart-level series colors as a comma-separated list of at least two hex colors; mutually exclusive with --color-palette

anchor_cell.description: Optional chart anchor cell such as F2; defaults to the right of the data range

width.description: Optional chart width; must be paired with --height; widen pie charts and charts with long category labels to avoid truncation

height.description: Optional chart height; must be paired with --width

url.description: Spreadsheet locator (target sheets are named inside --styles items)

cell_merges.description: 单元格合并操作数组；range 使用 A1 单元格范围，merge_type 默认 all。

cell_styles.description: 单元格样式操作数组；每项用 A1 单元格 range 指定范围，字段名与 +cells-set-style 对齐。加边框优先用 border 简写；只有分侧不同样式才用 border_styles 完整形态。

border.description: 边框简写（推荐）：{style, weight, color} 应用到四边（如 {"style":"solid","color":"#DDDDDD"}）；也接受侧键形态 {top:{…},bottom:{…}}。分侧不同样式用 border_styles 完整形态。

color.description: 边框颜色（十六进制，例如 "#000000"）

style.description: 边框线型；传 "none" 表示清除该方向边框（无边框线）

range.description: A1 单元格范围，必须落在该子表本次写入区域内；例如 A1:B1、B2。

col_sizes.description: 列宽操作数组；range 使用列范围如 A:C，给 size（px）即像素列宽（type 可省略）；type 为 standard 时不带 size。

freeze.description: 冻结行列：rows = 冻结前 N 行，cols = 冻结前 N 列（0 或省略 = 该维度不冻结）。作用于已有子表时（+styles-put / +table-put）全 0 = 两轴全部解冻；+workbook-create 建新表时全 0 无意义、会被校验拒绝。

name.description: 子表名。--sheets 模式下必须与同位置 --sheets.sheets[].name 一致；--values 模式下建议写 Sheet1（其 name 会被忽略）。

row_sizes.description: 行高操作数组；range 使用行范围如 1:3，给 size（px）即像素行高（type 可省略）；type 为 standard/auto 时不带 size。

styles.description: Visual spec JSON applied to an EXISTING spreadsheet: top-level `{styles:[...]}`, one item per target sheet (`name` is the real sheet name), each giving at least one of `cell_styles` / `cell_merges` / `row_sizes` / `col_sizes` / `freeze`. The vocabulary is identical to `--styles` on `+workbook-create` / `+table-put` (cell_styles = A1 range + flat style fields, borders via the `border` shorthand {style,weight,color} applied to all four sides — border_styles only for per-side differences; row/col sizes = row/column range + size in px — type only for standard/auto; merges = cell range; freeze = `{rows:N, cols:N}`). The whole spec expands into one batched request (fail-fast: do not assume what applied — read back to confirm before resending); ranges may target any region of the sheet；可直接传 JSON 对象或数组。

url.description: Spreadsheet locator (independent from per-operation sheet locator)

spreadsheet_token.description: Spreadsheet locator (independent from per-operation sheet locator)

anyOf.description: 要批量执行的 CLI shortcut 操作列表，按声明顺序串行执行；任一失败立即中断。

input.description: 该 shortcut 的入参集——含子表定位 sheet_id（或 sheet_name）。spreadsheet token/url 只需在顶层给一次；如果 input 里重复出现 excel_id / spreadsheet_token / url，CLI 会忽略它们且始终以顶层定位为准。input 的键是该 shortcut 的 flag 展平成 JSON、不是底层 MCP body。基础 flag 跑 `lark-cli sheets <shortcut> --help`，复合 JSON flag 跑 `--print-schema --flag-name <flag>`。不要手填 `operation`（动作由 shortcut 名表达）。

shortcut.description: CLI shortcut 名（不是底层 MCP tool 名）。图表与其它写入存在同批次顺序依赖时可作为子操作；多个互不依赖的图表任务优先用 +batch-chart-create / +batch-chart-update。+dim-move 不在表中——它走 legacy v2 endpoint，无法批；+cells-set-image / +workbook-create 也不在——前者含多步图片上传，后者是新建工作簿；所有读操作、fan-out wrapper（+batch-update 自身 / +styles-put / +cells-batch-set-style / +cells-batch-clear / +dropdown-{update,delete}）一律禁。

operations.description: JSON array: [{"shortcut":"+xxx-yyy","input":{...}}, ...]. shortcut uses CLI names; input is that shortcut's flag set — it includes the per-operation sheet locator (sheet_id or sheet_name) but not the spreadsheet token/url (pass that once at the top level via --url/--spreadsheet-token; +batch-update has no top-level --sheet-id). input keys are the shortcut's flags flattened into JSON (e.g. "range":"A11:B12"), not another nested layer. For basic flags use lark-cli sheets <shortcut> --help; for composite JSON flags use --print-schema --flag-name <flag>. Do not pass an explicit operation field. Fail-fast by default: the first failure aborts the remaining operations. Whether earlier sub-operations persisted is NOT uniform: pure cell/structure writes are only buffered and are dropped on failure (effective rollback), while chart/pivot-type sub-operations flush the buffered writes to disk before creating the object and cannot be rolled back. After a failure, assume neither full-rollback nor full-persist — check results, read back the current state (dims / target cells / object lists) to determine what actually applied, then resend only the unapplied part. Pass --continue-on-error to keep going past failures with successes preserved; no nesting; executed serially.；可直接传 JSON 对象或数组。

continue_on_error.description: Continue with remaining operations when a sub-operation fails; default false (abort on first failure)

oneOf.description: Target ranges as a JSON array (up to 100 items, e.g. `["Sheet1!A2:A100","Sheet1!C2:C100"]`, prefix written bare without quotes); each item must include a sheet prefix; the prefix must exactly match the sheet display name (case-sensitive), not the sheet reference_id

anyOf.description: 列表选项

options.description: Options as a JSON array, e.g. `["opt1","opt2"]`. Server enforces no item-count cap and no per-item length cap; values containing commas are accepted (they are escape-encoded on the wire). For very large lists prefer `--source-range`.；可直接传 JSON 对象或数组。

oneOf.description: Per-option pill background colors as an RGB hex array. Updating rewrites the entire validation rule: unless the user asks to reset colors, first read the dropdown with `+dropdown-get` and pass its existing `highlight_colors` through this flag; omission rebuilds colors from the built-in 10-color palette. For explicitly requested or semantic new colors, prefer light, low-saturation backgrounds because pill text is black. The array may be shorter than the source (`--options` items / `--source-range` cells) — extras use the built-in palette — but never longer (CLI Validate rejects: `--colors length (N) must not exceed dropdown source size (M)`). Applies on its own; ignored when `--highlight=false`.

colors.description: Per-option pill background colors as an RGB hex array. Updating rewrites the entire validation rule: unless the user asks to reset colors, first read the dropdown with `+dropdown-get` and pass its existing `highlight_colors` through this flag; omission rebuilds colors from the built-in 10-color palette. For explicitly requested or semantic new colors, prefer light, low-saturation backgrounds because pill text is black. The array may be shorter than the source (`--options` items / `--source-range` cells) — extras use the built-in palette — but never longer (CLI Validate rejects: `--colors length (N) must not exceed dropdown source size (M)`). Applies on its own; ignored when `--highlight=false`.；本地输入请提供 {"file_id":"..."}。

multiple.description: Enable multi-select. This flag only updates validation and does not write selected values. When writing selections with `+cells-set`, pass a `multiple_values` array, not a comma-joined `value`

highlight.description: Pill-highlight switch. **Omitted = ON** (options cycle through a 10-color palette). Pass `--highlight=false` for a plain dropdown. Override colors via `--colors`.

source_range.description: Source range for listFromRange dropdown (A1 + sheet prefix, e.g. `'Sheet1'!T1:T3`); maps to server `data_validation.range` and auto-sets `data_validation.type='listFromRange'`. XOR with `--options`: pass `--options` for an inline list (type=list), pass this for a range reference (type=listFromRange). `--colors` length rule unchanged (≤ source range cell count); `--highlight` / `--multiple` behave the same. When `--highlight` is on and the source covers more than 2000 cells, the server flags the dropdown as option-error (highlight + large source is an unsupported combo); CLI reports the warning in the result's `data.warnings`. Pass `--highlight=false` to suppress.

operations.description: Update an existing mail template. Supports --inspect (read-only projection), --print-patch-template (prints a JSON skeleton for --patch-file), and flat flags (--set-subject / --set-name / etc).
